reference_issues.description: Corda visivel desaparece na manga; continuidade, ponto inferior e pega exigem observacao propria, sem inferir que uma oclusao e uma ligacao correta.
reference_issues.instruction: Make both string-to-limb connections unambiguous. Keep the resting diagonal bow and declare any sleeve or hand occlusion; do not add a duplicate string or turn the bow into a staff.

reference_issues.description: Henrique, 28/10: "A corda esta atras do personagem, a arma esta mal feita". Na prancha a corda sai da ponta de cima e some atras da manga e do tronco; o arco nao tem construcao legivel.
reference_issues.instruction: Rebuild the bow: the string is one straight line from the upper nock to the lower nock, drawn IN FRONT of the body (over the sleeve and tunic), not hidden behind the character; keep the upper limb curve, the grip in the front hand, the lower tip at the rear hand and the resting gesture.
